title: Rasmiy elektron xat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida siz inglizcha rasmiy elektron xatlarni ishonch bilan yozasiz: aniq mavzu satri va salomlashish, maqsad–tafsilot–harakat strukturasi, rasmiy bog‘lovchilar (however, therefore, regarding), muloyim yopilish iboralari va imzo blokini sozlash, hamda so‘rov, javob va eslatma (reminder) xatlarini yozish.
homework_uz: Uchta rasmiy elektron xat yozing: (1) so‘rov xati — ma’lumot yoki xizmat so‘rash; (2) javob xati — hamkasbning xatiga professional javob; (3) eslatma xati — muddati o‘tayotgan vazifa bo‘yicha muloyim reminder. Har bir xatda aniq mavzu satri, maqsad–tafsilot–harakat strukturasi va rasmiy yopilish iborasi bo‘lsin; yuborishdan oldin har birini ovoz chiqarib o‘qing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: uchala xat 120 so‘zdan oshmasin, har birida kamida bitta rasmiy bog‘lovchi va bitta aniq harakat so‘rovi bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: P1-06 Uchrashuv va yig‘ilish.

vocab.uz: eslatma ('Following up on my email of…')

scenes.title: Rasmiy elektron xatga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda telefon qo‘ng‘iroqlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa yozma muloqotning asosi — rasmiy elektron xat. Xat sizning yuzingiz: shoshilib yozilgan xat professional obro‘yingizni tushirishi yoki ko‘tarishi mumkin. Dars oxirida siz so‘rov, javob va eslatma xatlarini ishonch bilan yozasiz — mavzu satridan imzogacha.
scenes.say: Welcome! Last lesson was phone calls. Today: the backbone of written professional life — the formal e-mail. A rushed message damages your reputation; a clean one builds it. By the end you'll write requests, replies and reminders — from subject line to signature.
scenes.say_uz: Assalomu alaykum! O‘tgan darsda telefon qo‘ng‘iroqlarni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa yozma muloqotning asosi — rasmiy elektron xat. Xat sizning yuzingiz: shoshilib yozilgani obro‘ingizni tushiradi, tozasi esa ko‘taradi. Dars oxirida siz so‘rov, javob va eslatma xatlarini mavzu satridan imzogacha ishonch bilan yozasiz.

scenes.title: Rasmiy xat nima va qachon ishlatiladi
board: Norasmiy: jamoa ichida — qisqa va bevosita
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy xat — sizni bilmagan yoki yuqori lavozimdagi odam o‘qiydi. Mijozlar, rahbariyat, audit, tashqi yetkazib beruvchilar — hammasi rasmiy ohang talab qiladi. Jamoa ichida norasmiy xat bo‘lishi mumkin: qisqa, bevosita, lekin baribir hurmatli. Yozishdan oldin o‘zingizga savol bering: 'Odamlar keng yig‘ilishida bu xatni ko‘rsatilgan bo‘lsa, uyalmaymanmi?' Yo‘q bo‘lsa — qayta yozing.
scenes.say: A formal e-mail is read by people who outrank you or barely know you: clients, leadership, auditors, vendors. Inside your team it can be casual — short, direct, still respectful. Ask yourself: 'Would I be embarrassed if this were shown in a meeting?' If yes, rewrite.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy xatni sizni yaxshi bilmagan yoki yuqori lavozimdagi odam o‘qiydi: mijozlar, rahbariyat, audit, tashqi hamkorlar — hammasi rasmiy ohang talab qiladi. Jamoada norasmiy bo‘lishi mumkin: qisqa, bevosita, lekin hurmatli. Savol bering: 'Bu xat yig‘ilishda ko‘rsatilsa, uyalmaymanmi?'

scenes.title: Subject line: 6–8 so‘z, kalit so‘zlar
board: Aniq harakat + ob’ekt: 'Request: March invoice copy'
Hech qachon 'Hi' yoki bo‘sh mavzu yo‘q

examples.t: Subject: Request — copy of invoice 4521 (due Friday)

scenes.say_native: Mavzu satri — xatning eshigi. Olti-sakkiz so‘zda nima haqida ekanligini yozing: harakat + ob’ekt — 'Request: copy of invoice 4521'. Job ID yoki sanani qo‘shing — '(due Friday)'. Hech qachon bo‘sh mavzu yoki 'Hi' qoldirmang — o‘qilmaydi. Muddati yaqin bo‘lsa, mavzuga sanani yozing; qabul qiluvchi darhol ustuvorlik tushunadi.
scenes.say: The subject line is the email's door. Six to eight words: action + object — 'Request: copy of invoice 4521'. Add a job ID or date — '(due Friday)'. Never leave it blank or write 'Hi'. If the deadline is near, put it in the subject — the reader grasps priority instantly.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu satri — xatning eshigi. Olti-sakkiz so‘zda: harakat + ob’ekt — 'Request: copy of invoice 4521'. Job ID yoki sana qo‘shing — '(due Friday)'. Bo‘sh mavzu yoki 'Hi' — o‘qilmaydi. Muddat yaqin bo‘lsa, sanani mavzuga yozing — qabul qiluvchi darhol ustuvorlikni tushunadi.

scenes.title: Greetings: salomlashishning uch darajasi

examples.t: Dear Ms Karimova, — Dear Sir or Madam (noma’lum bo‘lsa).
examples.uz: Dear Ms Karimova — nomi noma’lum bo‘lsa Dear Sir or Madam.

scenes.say_native: Salomlashish uch darajada. Eng rasmiy: 'Dear Mr Karimov,' — nuqta emas, vergul. Nomingizni bilmasangiz: 'Dear Sir or Madam,'. Tanish odamga: 'Hello Sandjar,' — neytral. 'Hi' faqat jamoa ichida. Unvon bilan murojaat qiling: Mr, Ms, Dr; 'Miss' emas, 'Ms' yozing — gender neytral va standart. Oxirida vergul qo‘ying, keyin xat matni yangi qatordan boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Three greeting levels. Most formal: 'Dear Mr Karimov,' — comma, not a period. Unknown addressee: 'Dear Sir or Madam,'. Someone you know: 'Hello Sandjar,' — neutral. 'Hi' is for inside the team. Prefer 'Ms' over 'Miss' — gender-neutral. End with a comma; the body starts on a new line.
scenes.say_uz: Salomlashish uch darajada. Eng rasmiy: 'Dear Mr Karimov,' — vergul, nuqta emas. Noma’lum adresat: 'Dear Sir or Madam,'. Tanish odamga: 'Hello Sandjar,' — neytral. 'Hi' — jamoa ichida. Unvonlar: Mr, Ms, Dr — 'Ms' ishlating, gender neytral. Oxirida vergul, matn yangi qatordan boshlanadi.

scenes.title: Structure: maqsad → tafsilot → harakat
board: 2. Tafsilot: 5W — kim, nima, nega, qachon, nima kerak

examples.t: Purpose (1 line) → details (5 lines) → ask (1 line).
examples.uz: Maqsad (1 qator) → tafsilot (5 qator) → so‘rov (1 qator).

scenes.say_native: Har rasmiy xat uch qismdan iborat. Birinchi — maqsad: 'I am writing to…' — bitta jumla, hech qanday kirish so‘zlarsiz. Ikkinchi — tafsilot: 5W — kim, nima, nega, qachon, nima kerakligi — besh qatordan oshmaydi. Uchinchi — harakat: 'Could you please…' + aniq muddat. Uch qism birga yuz yigirma so‘zdan oshmasin; uzun xatni hech kim o‘qimaydi.
scenes.say: Every formal email has three parts. One — purpose: 'I am writing to…', one sentence, no warm-up. Two — details, the 5W: who, what, why, when, what you need — five lines max. Three — action: 'Could you please…' with a specific deadline. Under one hundred and twenty words — long emails go unread.
scenes.say_uz: Har rasmiy xat uch qismdan iborat. Birinchi — maqsad: 'I am writing to…' — bitta jumla, kirishsiz. Ikkinchi — tafsilot, 5W: kim, nima, nega, qachon, nima kerak — besh qatordan oshmasin. Uchinchi — harakat: 'Could you please…' + aniq muddat. Uch qism birga yuz yigirma so‘zdan oshmasin.

scenes.title: Namuna: maqsadli request xat
scenes.say_native: Namuna xatni o‘qing va tuzilishiga qarang: mavzu satri, salomlashish, bir jumlalik maqsad, tafsilotlar ro‘yxati va aniq so‘rov muddati bilan. Har qism alohida qatorda — o‘qish oson, javob berish oson. Xat yuz so‘z ichida tugaydi va hech qanday ortiqcha so‘z yo‘q.
scenes.say: Subject: Request — copy of invoice 4521. Dear Ms Karimova, I am writing to request a copy of invoice 4521 for our March accounts. Our system shows it paid on 3 March, but the amount differs by 200,000 sums. Could you send the invoice PDF or confirm the correct total by Friday 12:00? Kind regards, Jasur Tokhtayev, Payme.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: So‘rov — 4521-schyot nusxasi. Dear Ms Karimova, I am writing to request a copy of invoice 4521 for our March accounts. Bizning tizimga ko‘ra 3-martda to‘langan, ammo summa 200,000 so‘mga farq qiladi. Juma 12:00 gacha PDF nusxasini yoki to‘g‘ri summani tasdiqlab bera olasizmi? Kind regards, Jasur Tokhtayev, Payme.

scenes.title: Subject line yozing
scenes.say_native: Endi mavzu satrini yozing. Tasavvur qiling: bulturgi audit hisobotining yakuniy nusxasini so‘raysiz. Harakat va ob’ektni birlashtiring: 'Request: final audit report — March'. Olti-sakkiz so‘zdan oshirmang, sanani qo‘shing va katta harf bilan boshlang. Yigirma soniya.
scenes.say: Write a subject line. Imagine you're requesting the final audit report from last month. Combine action and object: 'Request: final audit report — March'. Six to eight words, include the date, capitalise properly. Twenty seconds.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu satrini yozing. Tasavvur qiling: o‘tgan oydagi audit hisobotining yakuniy nusxasini so‘raysiz. Harakat va ob’ektni birlashtiring: 'Request: final audit report — March'. Olti-sakkiz so‘z, sana bilan, katta harf bilan boshlang. Yigirma soniya.

scenes.title: Maqsadni ochish: 'I am writing to…'
board: 'I am writing to request / confirm / inform you…'
Hech qanday 'I hope you are well' kirishsiz

examples.t: I am writing to confirm our meeting on Thursday.
examples.uz: Payshanba kungi uchrashuvimizni tasdiqlash uchun yozyapman.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi jumla maqsadni ochadi — boshqa hamma narsa ikkinchi o‘rinda. 'I am writing to request…', 'I am writing to confirm…', 'I am writing to inform you…'. Qo‘ng‘iroqdan keyin: 'Further to our call of yesterday…'. 'I hope you are well' — inglizcha xatlarda kam ishlatiladi; qisqa va aniq boshlang, qabul qiluvchining vaqtini hurmat qiling.
scenes.say: The first sentence opens the purpose — everything else comes second. 'I am writing to request…', 'I am writing to confirm…', 'I am writing to inform you…'. After a call: 'Further to our call of yesterday…'. Skip 'I hope you are well' — open short and precise.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi jumla maqsadni ochadi — qolgani ikkinchi o‘rinda. 'I am writing to request…', 'I am writing to confirm…'. Qo‘ng‘iroqdan keyin: 'Further to our call of yesterday…'. 'I hope you are well' kam ishlatiladi — qisqa va aniq boshlang, o‘quvchining vaqtini hurmat qiling.

scenes.title: Tafsilot: 5W savollari
board: Who: kim bilan bog‘liq, kim qiladi
What / Why: nima, nima uchun kerak

examples.t: Details: invoice 4521, paid 3 March, off by 200,000 sums.

scenes.say_native: Tafsilot qismi besh savolga javob beradi: Who — kim bilan bog‘liq; What — nima haqida; Why — nima uchun kerak; When — sana yoki muddat; What you need — aniq so‘rovingiz. Raqam, sana va havolalarni kiriting — 'the invoice 4521', 'paid on 3 March'. Umumiy gaplar o‘rniga aniq faktlar: qabul qiluvchi shu zahoti javob berishini xohlaydi, izlashni emas.
scenes.say: The details part answers five questions: Who — who it concerns; What — what it is about; Why — why it matters; When — date or deadline; What you need — the exact ask. Include numbers, dates, references: 'invoice 4521', 'paid on 3 March'. Facts over generalities.
scenes.say_uz: Tafsilot besh savolga javob beradi: Who — kim bilan bog‘liq; What — nima haqida; Why — nima uchun; When — sana yoki muddat; What you need — aniq so‘rovingiz. Raqam, sana, havolalar kiriting — 'invoice 4521', 'paid on 3 March'. Umumiy gaplar emas, aniq faktlar — o‘quvchi javob bersin, adashtirmanglarga kirmasin.

scenes.title: Harakat: 'Could you please…' + muddat

examples.t: Could you please confirm by Thursday 17:00?

scenes.say_native: Harakat qismi xatning yuragi. 'Could you please…' + aniq muddat: '…confirm by Thursday 17:00?'. Ilova bo‘lsa: 'Please find attached the draft.'. Bitta xatda bitta asosiy so‘rov bo‘lsin — uchta so‘rovli xat hech qaysi so‘rovni bajarmaydi. Aniq muddatsiz 'when you can' demang — kelajakdagi javobsizlik uchun yo‘riqnoma.
scenes.say: The action part is the heart of the email. 'Could you please…' plus a specific deadline: '…confirm by Thursday 17:00?' If there's an attachment: 'Please find attached the draft.' One email, one main ask — an email with three requests gets none done. Avoid 'when you can' — it's an instruction for future silence.
scenes.say_uz: Harakat qismi xatning yuragi. 'Could you please…' + aniq muddat: '…confirm by Thursday 17:00?' Ilova bo‘lsa: 'Please find attached the draft.' Bitta xatda bitta asosiy so‘rov — uch so‘rovli xat hech qaysi so‘rovni bajartirmaydi. Aniq muddat yo‘q 'when you can' demang — javobsizlikka yo‘riqnoma.

scenes.title: Namuna: to‘liq tuzilgan request xat
scenes.say_native: Namuna to‘liq xatni o‘qing: mavzu satri, salomlashish, maqsad bir jumlada, tafsilotlar aniq faktlar bilan, so‘rov muddat bilan va yopilish. Butun xat to‘qson so‘z — hech qanday suv, hech qanday kirish. Shunday xat besh daqiqada yoziladi va o‘n soniyada tushuniladi.
scenes.say: Subject: Request — API documentation for v2. Dear Mr Karimov, I am writing to request the API documentation for our Payme v2 integration. We signed the contract on 10 March, but the sandbox credentials are missing. Could you send the docs and credentials by Wednesday 18:00? Kind regards, Jasur.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: So‘rov — v2 uchun API hujjatlari. Dear Mr Karimov, I am writing to request the API documentation for our integration with Payme v2. Jamoamiz 10-martda shartnoma imzoladi, ammo sandbox ma’lumotlari yo‘q. Hujjatlar va kirish ma’lumotlarini chorshanba 18:00 gacha yubora olasizmi? Kind regards, Jasur.

scenes.title: Request xat yozing
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq request xat yozing. Tasavvur qiling: shartnoma imzosi uchun uchta hujjat kerak — tick bilan belgilang. Mavzu satrini, salomlashishni, bir jumlalik maqsadni, uch qatorga tafsilotni va muddat bilan so‘rovni yozing. Yigirma-uch o‘ttiz soniyada skeleti yozing, keyin ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.
scenes.say: Write a full request email aloud. Imagine you need three documents signed for a contract. Draft: subject line, greeting, one-line purpose, three lines of details, and the ask with a deadline. Thirty seconds to sketch the skeleton — then read it back aloud.
scenes.say_uz: To‘liq request xat yozing. Tasavvur qiling: shartnoma imzosi uchun uchta hujjat kerak. Yozing: mavzu satri, salomlashish, bir jumlalik maqsad, uch qator tafsilot va muddatli so‘rov. O‘ttiz soniyada skeletini chiqaring va ovoz chiqarib o‘qing.

scenes.title: Formal connectors: however, therefore, regarding
board: Qarshilik: however, nevertheless, on the other hand
Xulosa: therefore, thus, as a result
Mavzu: regarding, concerning, with regard to

examples.t: However, the delivery date has changed to 15 May.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy bog‘lovchilar xatga professional ohang beradi. Qarshilik: however, nevertheless, on the other hand. Xulosa: therefore, thus, as a result. Mavzu ko‘rsatish: regarding, concerning, with regard to. Qo‘shimcha: furthermore, in addition. Har xatda ikki-uchtasini ishlating — haddan tashqari ko‘p bog‘lovchi xatni sun’iy va og‘ir qiladi.
scenes.say: Formal connectors give an email its register. Contrast: however, nevertheless, on the other hand. Conclusion: therefore, thus, as a result. Topic: regarding, concerning, with regard to. Addition: furthermore, in addition. Two or three per email — more makes it stiff.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy bog‘lovchilar xatga professional ohang beradi. Qarshilik: however, nevertheless. Xulosa: therefore, thus, as a result. Mavzu: regarding, concerning. Qo‘shimcha: furthermore, in addition. Har xatda ikki-uchtaga ishlating — ortig‘i xatni og‘irlashtiradi.

scenes.title: Namuna: shartnomaga javob xati
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob xati — tashqi tomon shartnoma imzosi haqida so‘rayapti. Jasur tasdiqlaydi, furthermore bilan qo‘shimcha talab qo‘yadi va therefore bilan keyingi qadamni aniqlaydi. E’tibor bering: har bog‘lovchi yangi jumlaning boshida turadi va jumla nuqta bilan yakunlanadi.
scenes.say: Dear Mr Karimov, thank you for your email of 10 March. We confirm receipt of the contract draft; it will be signed by Thursday. However, we noticed the payment terms — sixty days instead of the agreed thirty. Furthermore, our accountant would like the VAT number on the invoice. Could you update the clause and resend the PDF? Therefore, once received, we sign within one business day. Kind regards, Jasur.
scenes.say_uz: Dear Mr Karimov, 10-martdagi xatingiz uchun rahmat. Shartnoma qoralasini olganingizni tasdiqlaymiz, u payshanba kuni imzolanadi. However, to‘lov muddatida kelishilgan 30 o‘rniga 60 kun ko‘rsatilganini sezdik. Furthermore, hisobchi hisob-fakturaga VAT raqamini qo‘shishni so‘rayapti. Iltimos, bo‘limni yangilab, PDFni qayta yuboring. Therefore, olgandan keyin bir ish kunida imzolaymiz. Kind regards, Jasur.

scenes.title: Reply mashqi: tasdiqlash xati
scenes.say_native: Endi javob xati mashqini bajaring. Xayoliy vaziyat: tashqi tomon shartnoma yubordi, siz uni tasdiqlaysiz, bitta tuzatish so‘raysiz va keyingi qadamni belgilaysiz. 'Thank you for your email of…' deb boshlang, however va furthermore ishlating, therefore bilan yakunlang. Yigirma besh soniyada strukturani aytib bering.
scenes.say: Practise the reply aloud. Scenario: an external partner sent a contract; you accept, request one edit, and set the next step. Open with 'Thank you for your email of…', use however and furthermore, close with therefore. Twenty-five seconds — speak the structure.
scenes.say_uz: Javob xati mashqini bajaring. Vaziyat: tashqi tomon shartnoma yubordi; siz tasdiqlaysiz, bitta tuzatish so‘raysiz, keyingi qadamni belgilaysiz. 'Thank you for your email of…' deb boshlang, however va furthermore ishlating, therefore bilan yakunlang. Yigirma besh soniyada.

scenes.title: Tinglash 1: xatni birga ko‘rib chiqish
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash — hamkasb xatni boshqa hamkasbga ovoz chiqarib o‘qib ko‘rsatadi. Nilufar xatdagi uch muammoni topadi: mavzu satri noaniq, iltimos ohangi qattiq va so‘rovda muddat yo‘q. Jasur xatni shu joyida qayta yozadi. Diqqat bilan tinglang — savollar keyingi sahifada beriladi.
scenes.say: Jasur: Read this — 'Hi, send me the report. It's urgent. Thanks.' Nilufar: Three problems. One: the subject is empty. Jasur: I'll write 'Request — Q1 report (due Thursday)'. Nilufar: Two: 'send me' is an order. Jasur: Change it to 'Could you please send…'. Nilufar: Three: no deadline — what does 'urgent' mean to you versus to them? Jasur: I'll set Thursday 17:00 and sign off with 'Kind regards'. Nilufar: Now it's an email. Jasur: Rewriting now.
scenes.say_uz: Jasur: Buni o‘qib beraman — 'Hi, send me the report. It's urgent. Thanks.' Nilufar: Uch muammo bor. Bir: mavzu satri bo‘sh. Jasur: To‘g‘ri, 'Request — Q1 report (due Thursday)' deb yozaman. Nilufar: Ikki: 'send me' — buyruq, so‘rov emas. Jasur: 'Could you please send…' ga o‘zgartiraman. Nilufar: Uch: muddat yo‘q — 'urgent' senga va ularga nimani anglatadi? Jasur: Payshanba 17:00 qo‘yaman va 'Kind regards' bilan yakunlayman. Nilufar: Endi bu xat bo‘ldi. Jasur: Rozimiz — qayta yozaman.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 1
board: 4 Jasur qaysi muddat va ohangni qo‘shdi?
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: xatdagi uch muammo nima edi? Ikki: yangi mavzu satri nima bo‘ldi? Uch: 'send me' iborasi nimaga o‘zgartirildi? To‘rt: Jasur qaysi muddatni va qaysi ohangni qo‘shdi? Javoblarni ichingizda tartib bilan qayd eting — keyingi sahifada tekshiramiz.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what were the three problems in the email? Two: what did the new subject line become? Three: what was 'send me' changed to? Four: what deadline and closing tone did Jasur add? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: xatdagi uch muammo nima edi? Ikki: yangi mavzu satri nima bo‘ldi? Uch: 'send me' nimaga o‘zgartirildi? To‘rt: Jasur qaysi muddat va ohangni qo‘shdi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 1
board: 1. Mavzu bo‘sh, buyruq ohangi, muddat yo‘q
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: uch muammo — mavzu satri bo‘sh, buyruq ohangi va muddat yo‘q. Ikki: yangi mavzu satri 'Request — Q1 report (due Thursday)'. Uch: 'send me' — 'Could you please send…' ga o‘zgartirildi. To‘rt: payshanba 17:00 muddati qo‘shildi va 'Kind regards' bilan yopildi — buyruq emas, so‘rov bo‘ldi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: empty subject, commanding tone, no deadline. Two: 'Request — Q1 report (due Thursday)'. Three: 'send me' became 'Could you please send…'. Four: a Thursday 17:00 deadline was added and it closes with 'Kind regards' — a request, no longer an order.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: bo‘sh mavzu, buyruq ohangi, muddatsiz. Ikki: 'Request — Q1 report (due Thursday)'. Uch: 'send me' — 'Could you please send…' ga o‘zgartirildi. To‘rt: payshanba 17:00 muddati va 'Kind regards' yopilishi qo‘shildi — endi so‘rov.

scenes.title: Eslatma xati: 'Following up…'
board: 'Following up on my email of 10 March…'

examples.t: Following up on my email of 10 March — any update?

scenes.say_native: Eslatma xati tanqid emas, xotira yangilash. 'Following up on my email of 10 March…' — sanani ko‘rsating. 'Just a gentle reminder that the deadline is Thursday…' — yumshoq. 'I wanted to check whether you had a chance to review…' — eng muloyim. Egasiga emas, ishga e’tibor qarating — shuhrat oshmaydi.
scenes.say: A reminder refreshes memory — it doesn't accuse. 'Following up on my email of 10 March…' names the date. 'Just a gentle reminder that the deadline is Thursday…' is soft. 'I wanted to check whether you've had a chance to review…' is the gentlest. Target the task, not the person.
scenes.say_uz: Eslatma xati tanqid emas, xotira yangilash. 'Following up on my email of 10 March…' — sanani ayting. 'Just a gentle reminder that the deadline is Thursday…' — yumshoq. 'I wanted to check whether you've had a chance to review…' — eng muloyim. Insonga emas, ishga qaratilgan.

scenes.title: Namuna: reminder xati
scenes.say_native: Namuna reminder — muloyim, qisqa va aniq. Jasur avvalgi xatning sanasini eslatadi, asl so‘rovni bir qatorda takrorlaydi va yengil harakat taklif qiladi. Hech qanday 'Men bultur yozgan edim' kabi kinoya yo‘q — faqat muloyim xotira yangilash va oson javob imkoni.
scenes.say: Subject: Following up — invoice 4521 copy. Dear Ms Karimova, I hope you're well. Following up on my email of 10 March — any chance you've looked at invoice 4521? Our March close is on Friday, so a quick confirmation would help. If easier, I'm happy to jump on a five-minute call. Kind regards, Jasur.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: Eslatma — 4521-schyot nusxasi. Dear Ms Karimova, I hope you are well. 10-martdagi xatim bo‘yicha eslataman — 4521-schyotni ko‘rishga ulgurdingizmi? Bizning mart oyining yopilishi juma kuni, shuning uchun tez tasdiqlash juda yordam beradi. Osonroq bo‘lsa, besh daqiqalik qo‘ng‘iroqqa tayyorman. Kind regards, Jasur.

scenes.title: Reminder mashqi yozing
scenes.say_native: Endi reminder mashqini bajaring. Tasavvur qiling: o‘tgan haftada hujjat so‘ragansiz, javob yo‘q. 'Following up on my email of…' deb boshlang, asl so‘rovni bir qatorda eslating, muddatni ayting va oson javob varianti taklif qiling — qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq yoki faqat 'ha/yo‘q' javobi. Yigirma besh soniyada yozing.
scenes.say: Practise the reminder aloud. Scenario: you requested documents last week, no answer. Open with 'Following up on my email of…', restate the ask in one line, name the deadline, and offer a low-effort reply — a quick call or a yes/no. Twenty-five seconds, no blame.
scenes.say_uz: Reminder mashqini qiling. Vaziyat: o‘tgan haftada hujjat so‘ragansiz, javob yo‘q. 'Following up on my email of…' bilan boshlang, so‘rovni bir qatorda eslating, muddatni ayting va oson javob taklif qiling — qisqa qo‘ng‘iroq yoki 'ha/yo‘q'. Yigirma besh soniya, tanqidsiz.

scenes.title: Tinglash 2: shikoyat xatiga javob
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi tinglash — mijozning kechikkan yetkazib berish haqidagi shikoyat xatiga Nilufar javob yozadi. Nilufar avval uzrini tan oladi, keyin muammoni izohlaydi va aniq yechim bilan muddat beradi. Xat muloyim, tan olinadigan va yechimga yo‘naltirilgan. Diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: Nilufar: Dear Mr Rashidov, thank you for flagging the late delivery — I sincerely apologise. We found the delay in our warehouse; your order left on Tuesday, not Monday. Therefore, your new slot is Thursday 09:00–12:00. We've added free express shipping as an apology. Furthermore, here's the updated tracking link. Kind regards, Nilufar.
scenes.say_uz: Nilufar: Dear Mr Rashidov, kechikkan yetkazib berishni bildirganingiz uchun rahmat — chin dildan uzr so‘raymiz. Omborimizda kechikish topildi; buyurtmangiz dushanba emas, seshanba kuni chiqdi. Therefore, yangi yetkazib berish sanasi — payshanba 09:00–12:00. Uzr sifatida ushbu buyurtma uchun bepul ekspress yetkazib berish qo‘shildi. Furthermore, yangilangan tracking havolasini ilova qilyapman. Kind regards, Nilufar.

scenes.title: Tinglash savollari 2
scenes.say_native: To‘rt savol. Bir: mijoz nima uchun shikoyat qildi? Ikki: Nilufar kechikishni qanday izohladi? Uch: Nilufar qanday yechim va yangi muddat taklif qildi? To‘rt: uzr sifatida nima qo‘shildi? Javoblarni tartib bilan ichingizda qayd eting va keyingi sahifada tekshiring.
scenes.say: Four questions. One: what did the customer complain about? Two: how did Nilufar explain the delay? Three: what solution and which new deadline did she offer? Four: what apology was added? Answers in your head.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt savol. Bir: mijoz nima uchun shikoyat qildi? Ikki: Nilufar kechikishni qanday izohladi? Uch: Nilufar qanday yechim va yangi sanani taklif qildi? To‘rt: uzr sifatida nima qo‘shildi? Javoblarni ichingizda ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tinglash 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: yetkazib berish kechikkani uchun shikoyat qilindi. Ikki: Nilufar kechikishni ombor ichida ekanligini va buyurtma seshanba kuni chiqqanini izohladi. Uch: yangi yetkazib berish sanasi — payshanba 09:00 dan 12:00 gacha; hal qilinish va’da qilindi. To‘rt: uzr sifatida bepul ekspress yetkazib berish qo‘shildi va tracking havolasi ilova qilindi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: the delivery was late. Two: she explained the delay happened in the warehouse — the order left on Tuesday, not Monday. Three: the new slot is Thursday 09:00–12:00. Four: as an apology, free express shipping was added and the tracking link attached — concrete action, not just words.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: yetkazib berish kech qoldi. Ikki: kechikish omborda — buyurtma seshanba kuni chiqdi. Uch: yangi sana — payshanba 09:00–12:00. To‘rt: bepul ekspress yetkazib berish qo‘shildi va tracking ilova qilindi — faqat so‘z emas, aniq harakat.

scenes.title: Attachments: ilovalarni to‘g‘ri yozish
board: 'I have attached the PDF for your review'

examples.t: Please find attached the signed contract.

scenes.say_native: Ilovalar haqida besh qoida. Bir: 'Please find attached…' — eng rasmiy ibora. Ikki: 'I have attached the PDF for your review' — shaxsliroq variant. Uch: fayl nomini ayting: '…the invoice PDF (Invoice_4521.pdf)'. To‘rt: yuborishdan oldin albatta fayl haqiqatan ham biriktirilganini tekshirig — eng keng tarqalgan professional xato. Besh: katta fayllar uchun havola ishlating.
scenes.say: Five rules for attachments. One: 'Please find attached…' — the formal standard. Two: 'I have attached the PDF for your review' — warmer. Three: name the file — '…the invoice PDF (Invoice_4521.pdf)'. Four: verify the file is genuinely attached — the most common professional mistake. Five: large files? Use a link.
scenes.say_uz: Ilovalar haqida besh qoida. Bir: 'Please find attached…' — rasmiy ibora. Ikki: 'I have attached the PDF for your review' — issiqroq variant. Uch: fayl nomini ayting — 'Invoice_4521.pdf'. To‘rt: yuborishdan oldin fayl haqiqatan biriktirilganini tekshiring — eng keng tarqalgan xato. Besh: katta fayl uchun havola.

scenes.title: Yopilish formulalari va imzo bloki
scenes.say_native: Yopilish uch variant: 'Kind regards,' — universal, har doim ishlaydi; 'Yours sincerely,' — adresat ismi ma’lum bo‘lsa; 'Yours faithfully,' — faqat 'Dear Sir or Madam' ishlatganingizda. Yopilishdan keyin imzo bloki: ismingiz, lavozimingiz, kompaniya, telefon va veb-havola. Hech qachon faqat ism bilan tugatmang — qabul qiluvchi sizni izlash uchun vaqt sarflaydi.
scenes.say: Three closings: 'Kind regards,' — universal, always safe; 'Yours sincerely,' — when you know the name; 'Yours faithfully,' — only after 'Dear Sir or Madam'. Below the closing, the signature block: your name, title, company, phone, web link. Never end on just a first name.
scenes.say_uz: Uch yopilish: 'Kind regards,' — universal; 'Yours sincerely,' — ism ma’lum bo‘lsa; 'Yours faithfully,' — 'Dear Sir or Madam' dan keyin. Yopilish ostida imzo bloki: ism, lavozim, kompaniya, telefon, havola. Faqat ism bilan tugatmang — o‘quvchi sizni izlamasligi kerak.

scenes.title: Acknowledge: olganingizni tasdiqlang

examples.t: Received, thank you — I'll review today and revert tomorrow.
examples.uz: Oldim, rahmat — bugun ko‘rib chiqaman va ertaga javob beraman.

scenes.say_native: Xat olgansiz — darhol acknowledge yuboring: 'Received, thank you — I'll review today and revert tomorrow.'. Bu ikki jumla yuboruvchining xavotirini o‘chiradi va sizni tashkilotli ko‘rsatadi. To‘liq javob uchun vaqt kerak bo‘lsa ham, qabul qilganingizni darrov yozing — javobsizlik har doim yomon ohangda qabul qilinadi.
scenes.say: Got an email? Acknowledge instantly: 'Received, thank you — I'll review today and revert tomorrow.' Those two lines kill the sender's anxiety and mark you as organised. Even when a full answer needs time, confirm receipt at once — silence is always read as rudeness.
scenes.say_uz: Xat oldingizmi? Darhol acknowledge yozing: 'Received, thank you — I'll review today and revert tomorrow.' Ikki jumla yuboruvchining xavotirini o‘chiradi va sizni tashkilotli ko‘rsatadi. To‘liq javob kechiksa ham, qabul qilganingizni darrov yozing — javobsizlik yomon ohangda qabul qilinadi.

scenes.title: Reply all, CC va BCC: odob qoidalari
board: Reply all — faqat hamma bilishi kerak bo‘lsa
CC — xabardor qilish uchun, harakat uchun emas

examples.t: Use CC for visibility, not for action.
examples.uz: CC — xabardorlik uchun, harakat uchun emas.

scenes.say_native: Reply all tuzog‘i: 'Thanks everyone!' — o‘ttiz kishiga kerakmas xat. Reply all faqat u barchaga muhim bo‘lsa. CC — kimnidir xabardor qilasiz, lekin harakat kutmaysiz; harakat kutsangiz, To qatoriga qo‘ying. BCC — ro‘yxatlarga yuborishda; hech qachon hamkasblarni bir-biriga yashirincha qo‘shmang — oshkor bo‘lganda ishonch yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: The reply-all trap: 'Thanks everyone!' — thirty people didn't need that. Reply all only when it concerns everyone. CC — informed, no action expected; if you need action, put them in To. BCC — for mass lists; never secretly copy colleagues.
scenes.say_uz: Reply all tuzog‘i: 'Thanks everyone!' — o‘ttiz kishiga keraksiz xat. Reply all faqat hammaga muhim bo‘lsa. CC — xabardor qilasiz, harakat kutmaysiz; harakat kerak bo‘lsa, To qatoriga qo‘ying. BCC — ro‘yxatlar uchun; hamkasblarni bir-biriga yashirincha qo‘shmang — oshkor bo‘lganda ishonch yo‘qoladi.

scenes.title: Ton: would, could, might — yumshoq kuch
board: Qattiq so‘zlar: must, need, wrong, fail

examples.t: I would appreciate it if you could confirm by Friday.
examples.uz: Juma kunigacha tasdiqlab bersangiz, mamnun bo‘lardim.

scenes.say_native: Rasmiy xatning quroli — yumshoq kuch: would, could, might. 'I would appreciate it if…' — 'I want' o‘rniga. 'It might help to…' — 'You need to' o‘rniga. Qattiq so‘zlardan qoching: must, need, wrong, fail — ular xatni buyruqqa aylantiradi. Yo‘naltirish uchun: qisqa jumlalar yumshoq modallar bilan — eng kuchli rasmiy kombinatsiya.
scenes.say: The formal email's weapon is soft power: would, could, might. 'I would appreciate it if…' replaces 'I want'. 'It might help to…' replaces 'You need to'. Avoid the hard words — must, need, wrong, fail — they turn an email into an order. Short sentences, soft modals: the strongest formal combination.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy xatning quroli — yumshoq kuch: would, could, might. 'I would appreciate it if…' — 'I want' o‘rniga. 'It might help to…' — 'You need to' o‘rniga. Qattiq so‘zlar — must, need, wrong, fail — xatni buyruqqa aylantiradi. Qisqa jumlalar + yumshoq modallar = eng kuchli rasmiy kombinatsiya.

scenes.title: 'I look forward to' va javob berish normasi
board: 'I look forward to hearing from you'

examples.t: I look forward to your reply by Thursday.

scenes.say_native: Yakun iboralari yopilishdan oldin keladi: 'I look forward to your reply' yoki '…to hearing from you'. Yozilmagan qonun: xatlarga yigirma to‘rt soat ichida acknowledge qaytaring, to‘liq javobni uch ish kuni ichida bering. Ta’til yoki band davr bo‘lsa, oldindan xabar bering: 'I'll be away 5–12 May; for urgent matters, contact X.'
scenes.say: Sign-off phrases come just before the closing: 'I look forward to your reply' or '…to hearing from you'. The unwritten rule: acknowledge within twenty-four hours; full answer within three business days. Away? Say so in advance: 'I'll be away 5–12 May; for urgent matters, contact X.'
scenes.say_uz: Yopilishdan oldingi iboralar: 'I look forward to your reply' yoki '…to hearing from you'. Yozilmagan qonun: xatlarga yigirma to‘rt soat ichida acknowledge qaytaring, to‘liq javob uch ish kunida. Ta’tilda bo‘lsangiz, oldindan ayting: 'I'll be away 5–12 May; for urgent matters, contact X.'

scenes.title: Sanalar va vaqtlar: bir xil format
board: 03.04.2026 — US va UK o‘qishi farq qiladi
scenes.say_native: Xatdagi sanalar chalkashlik manbai. Bitta format tanlang: 'Thursday 15 May 2026' yoki '15 May 2026'; US'da 'May 15, 2026'. Vaqtni 24-soat formatida yozing: '17:00'. Minglarni vergul bilan ajrating: '1,200,000 sums'. Formatlarni hech qachon aralashtirmang — 03.04.2026 kimga 3-aprel, kimga 4-mart.
scenes.say: Dates in email confuse people. Pick one format: 'Thursday 15 May 2026' or '15 May 2026'; US: 'May 15, 2026'. Time in 24-hour style: '17:00'. Separate thousands: '1,200,000 sums'. Never mix conventions — 03.04.2026 means April 3rd to some, March 4th to others.
scenes.say_uz: Xatdagi sanalar chalkashlik manbai. Formatni tanlang: 'Thursday 15 May 2026' yoki '15 May 2026'; US'da 'May 15, 2026'. Vaqt 24-soat formatida: '17:00'. Minglarni ajrating: '1,200,000 sums'. Formatlarni aralashtirmang — 03.04.2026 kimga 3-aprel, kimga 4-mart.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha ongidan o‘tgan 6 xato
scenes.say_native: Olti xatoni tuzlang. Bir: 'Dear Sir/Madam' eskirgan — 'Dear Sir or Madam,' ishlating yoki ismni toping. Ikki: ruscha tartibdagi uzun gaplar o‘rniga qisqa inglizcha jumlalar. Uch: katta harf faqat gap boshida va maxsus nomlarda. To‘rt: undov belgilari rasmiy xatda joyi yo‘q. Besh: 'Please find attached' yozib, ilova qilishni unutish. Oltinchi: 'please' siz buyruq — ohang sovuq.
scenes.say: Fix six mistakes. One: 'Dear Sir/Madam' is dated — use 'Dear Sir or Madam,' or find the name. Two: long Russian-order sentences become short English ones. Three: capitals only at sentence starts and proper names. Four: exclamation marks don't belong in formal mail. Five: writing 'Please find attached' without the file. Six: commands without 'please' — cold by default.
scenes.say_uz: Olti xatoni tuzlang. Bir: 'Dear Sir/Madam' eskirgan — 'Dear Sir or Madam,' ishlating. Ikki: uzun ruscha tartibda o‘rniga qisqa inglizcha jumlalar. Uch: katta harf faqat gap boshida. To‘rt: undov belgilari yo‘q. Besh: 'Please find attached' yozilsa, ilova qilish kerak. Oltinchi: 'please' siz buyruq — ohang sovuq.

scenes.title: Xatolarni tuzating
scenes.say_native: Uchta xatoni tuzlang. 'Dear Sir/Madam' → 'Dear Sir or Madam,' — vergul bilan. 'SEND ME THE REPORT!!!' → 'Could you please send me the report by Thursday?' — muloyim va muddatli. 'Attached is the file' lekin ilova yo‘q — yuborishdan oldin ilovani tekshiring yoki 'I'll send the file in a moment' deb to‘g‘rilang. Har birini ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: Fix three emails. 'Dear Sir/Madam' → 'Dear Sir or Madam,' with a comma. 'SEND ME THE REPORT!!!' → 'Could you please send me the report by Thursday?' — polite with a deadline. 'Attached is the file' with nothing attached — verify the file, or correct yourself: 'I'll send the file in a moment'.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta xatni tuzlang: 'Dear Sir/Madam' → 'Dear Sir or Madam,' — vergul bilan; 'SEND ME THE REPORT!!!' → 'Could you please send me the report by Thursday?'; 'Attached is the file' lekin ilova yo‘q → ilovani tekshiring yoki to‘g‘rilang: 'I'll send the file in a moment'.

scenes.title: Uch xat ketma-ket: request, reply, reminder
scenes.say_native: To‘liq uch xat mashqini bajaring. Bir: audit hisoboti nusxasini so‘rang — mavzu, maqsad, so‘rov. Ikki: hamkasbning 'tasdiqlaysizmi?' xatiga javob yozing — terima, tuzatish, keyingi qadam. Uch: o‘tgan xatingizga javob yo‘q — muloyim reminder. Ovoz chiqarib, har biriga qirq so‘zdan oshirmasdan aytib bering. Qirq soniya.
scenes.say: Now the full triple aloud: One — request a copy of the audit report: subject, purpose, ask. Two — reply to a colleague's 'could you confirm?' email: accept, request one edit, next step. Three — no reply yet to your earlier email: a polite reminder. Each under forty words, spoken aloud, forty seconds total.
scenes.say_uz: Uch xatni ovoz chiqarib aytib bering. Bir: audit hisoboti nusxasini so‘rang — mavzu, maqsad, so‘rov. Ikki: hamkasbning 'tasdiqlaysizmi?' xatiga javob — qabul qiling, bitta tuzatish so‘rang, keyingi qadamni belgilang. Uch: javobsiz qolgan xatingizga muloyim reminder yozing. Har biri qirq so‘zdan oshmasin. Qirq soniya.

scenes.title: Bugungi darsning xulosasi
board: Acknowledgment 24 soat ichida, yopilish — Kind regards
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Mavzu satri — olti-sakkiz so‘zda harakat va ob’ekt. Xat strukturasi — maqsad, tafsilot, harakat; yuz yigirma so‘zdan oshmasin. However, therefore, regarding — ikkita-uchta rasmiy bog‘lovchi yetadi. Xatga yigirma to‘rt soat ichida acknowledge qaytaring; yopilish — 'Kind regards'. Va yuborishdan oldin fayl haqiqatan ilova qilinganligini tekshiring.
scenes.say: Sum up. Subject: six to eight words, action plus object. Structure: purpose, details, action — under one hundred and twenty words. However, therefore, regarding — two or three connectors suffice. Acknowledge within twenty-four hours; close with 'Kind regards'. Always verify the file is actually attached.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Mavzu satri: olti-sakkiz so‘z, harakat + ob’ekt. Struktura: maqsad, tafsilot, harakat — yuz yigirma so‘zdan oshmasin. However, therefore, regarding — ikkita-uchta bog‘lovchi yetadi. Yigirma to‘rt soat ichida acknowledge; yopilish — 'Kind regards'. Va fayl ilova qilinganligini tekshiring.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi va keyingi dars
board: Har birida rasmiy bog‘lovchi + muddatli so‘rov
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: uchta rasmiy elektron xat yozing. Bir — so‘rov: ma’lumot yoki xizmat so‘rang. Ikki — javob: hamkasbning xatiga professional javob. Uch — eslatma: muddati o‘tayotgan vazifa bo‘yicha muloyim reminder. Har birida aniq mavzu satri, maqsad–tafsilot–harakat strukturasi va rasmiy yopilish bo‘lsin. Keyingi darsda yig‘ilishlarni o‘rganamiz — kun tartibi, taqdimot va qaror qabul qilish. Omad tilayman!
scenes.say: Homework: three formal e-mails. One — request: ask for information or a service. Two — reply: a professional answer. Three — reminder: a polite nudge on an approaching deadline. Each with a clear subject line, the purpose-details-action structure. Next lesson: meetings — agenda, presentation, decision-making. Good luck!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: uchta rasmiy elektron xat yozing. Bir — so‘rov: ma’lumot yoki xizmat so‘rang. Ikki — javob: hamkasb xatiga professional javob. Uch — eslatma: muddati o‘tayotgan vazifa bo‘yicha muloyim reminder. Har birida aniq mavzu satri, maqsad–tafsilot–harakat strukturasi va rasmiy yopilish bo‘lsin. Keyingi dars: uchrashuv va yig‘ilish. Omad tilayman!

quiz.q: Which subject line is the strongest?
quiz.why_uz: Harakat + ob’ekt + muddat — eng kuchli mavzu satri; qabul qiluvchi ustuvorlikni bir qarashda tushunadi.

quiz.q: What is the professional structure of a formal email body?
options: Purpose (one line), details, action with a deadline
quiz.why_uz: Maqsad — bitta jumla; tafsilot — 5W; harakat — could you please + muddat; yuz yigirma so‘zdan oshmasin.

quiz.q: Which greeting is correct if you don't know the addressee's name?
quiz.why_uz: Ism noma’lum bo‘lsa, 'Dear Sir or Madam,' — vergul bilan; yopilishda esa 'Yours faithfully,' bo‘ladi.

quiz.q: Which closing pairs with 'Dear Sir or Madam,'?
quiz.why_uz: Adresat ismi ma’lum bo‘lsin — 'Yours sincerely,'; noma’lum bo‘lsin — 'Yours faithfully,'; ikkalasida xat imzo bloki bilan tugaydi.

quiz.q: How soon should you acknowledge an email?
options: Within 24 hours, even if the full answer takes longer
Only when you have the full answer
quiz.why_uz: Yigirma to‘rt soat ichida olganingizni tasdiqlang — ikki qatorlik acknowledge yuboruvchining xavotirini o‘chiradi.

options: For every email to be safe
Only when the whole group needs it
When you want to thank everyone
quiz.why_uz: Reply all faqat barchaga muhim bo‘lsa — 'Thanks everyone!' xatlari o‘ttiz kishini band qiladi va professionalliksiz ko‘rinadi.
However — qarshilik bog‘lovchisi: 'We confirm receipt. However, we noticed…'. Therefore — xulosa, regarding — mavzu, furthermore — qo‘shimcha.

quiz.q: What is the best way to chase a missing answer?
options: 'Following up on my email of 10 March — any update?'
Send the email again marked URGENT
quiz.why_uz: Muloyim reminder — sana ko‘rsatib, asl so‘rovni takrorlab, oson javob yo‘lini taklif qiling; kinoya va qattiq so‘zlar javobni sekinlashtiradi.

quiz.q: What must you check before sending with 'Please find attached'?
options: That the file is genuinely attached
quiz.why_uz: 'Ilova qilindi' yozib, fayl biriktirishni unutish — eng keng tarqalgan professional xato; yuborishdan oldin tekshiring.

quiz.q: Which is a professional sign-off before the closing?
options: 'I look forward to your reply by Thursday.'
quiz.why_uz: 'I look forward to your reply' — muloyim va kutishni bildiradi; 'ASAP' va '???' buyruq va sabrsizlikdan nishon.
